sumInsured: As per Policy Schedule (not provided in extract)

great.name: Room rent / room category: No sub-limit (Any room)
great.quote: Eligibility of Room Category of the insured person is 'no sub-limit', which means that there is no separate restriction on Room/Boarding and nursing expenses in case of Hospitalization.
great.explanation: Default plan has no room category restriction, so you can choose any room type without room-rent capping impacting eligibility.

great.name: Restore (Automatic Recharge): once per year, usable for same illness too
great.quote: automatically make the re-instatement of up to the base Sum Insured once in a policy year... Recharge amount can be utilized for same illness as well as different Illnesses.
great.explanation: After you exhaust base SI (and other listed buckets), the policy can restore up to base SI once per policy year, and it can be used even for the same illness.

great.name: Built-in additional Sum Insured buffer for accidents (Optional Cover): activates after base SI exhausted
great.quote: the Company shall automatically provide an additional Sum Insured equal to the Sum Insured... (i) ...utilized only after the Sum Insured has been completely exhausted;
great.reference: Clause 3.2.10 – Optional Cover 10 Additional Sum Insured for Accidental Hospitalization
great.explanation: If you opt this cover, you get an extra SI for accidental hospitalization that kicks in after exhausting the existing SI, improving protection in high-cost accidental events.

great.name: Modern/advanced treatments listed (no sub-limit mentioned in clause)
great.quote: The Company will indemnify... for treatment taken through following advance technology methods: ... Robotic surgeries ... Immunotherapy- Monoclonal Antibody ... Stem cell therapy: Hematopoietic stem cells...
great.explanation: The policy explicitly covers multiple modern treatment modalities under hospitalization, reducing the risk of denial merely because the treatment is advanced/tech-enabled.

good.name: Pre-existing disease (PED) waiting period: 36 months
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED)... shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage
good.explanation: 3-year PED wait is within common market range.

good.name: Specific illness/procedure waiting period: 24 months
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage

good.name: Initial waiting period: 30 days (illness), accident covered from day 1
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Standard initial wait for illnesses; accidents are exempt.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization cover: 30 days
good.quote: Under Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses, for a period of 30 days immediately prior to the Insured Person's date of admission
good.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for 30 days before admission, linked to an admissible hospitalization claim.

good.name: Post-hospitalization cover: 60 days
good.quote: Under Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses, for a period of 60 days immediately after the Insured Person's date of discharge
good.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for 60 days after discharge, linked to an admissible hospitalization claim.

bad.name: Consumables / non-medical items not covered (out-of-pocket)
bad.quote: Any item or condition or treatment specified in List of Non-Medical Items (Annexure – II to Policy Terms & Conditions).
bad.reference: Clause 4.2(a)(1) + Annexure II (List of Expenses Generally Excluded)
bad.explanation: Items like gloves, masks, nebulisation kit, etc. listed in Annexure II can become out-of-pocket unless billed in a way that is subsumed/allowed as per that annexure structure.

bad.name: NCB reduces on claim (can reduce next year)
bad.quote: In the event of a Claim occurring during any Policy Year, the accrued No Claims Bonus will be reduced at same rate at which it is accrued at the commencement of next Policy Year;
bad.explanation: Your accumulated NCB is not fully protected; it can reduce after a claim, which limits long-term SI build-up.

unclear.name: Co-payment: % not specified in wording (depends on Policy Schedule / optional covers chosen)
unclear.quote: The Co-payment proportion (if applicable) as specified in the Policy Schedule shall be borne by the Policyholder / Insured Person on each Claim
unclear.reference: General Conditions Applicable to all the Benefits – Point 3
unclear.explanation: The document confirms co-pay can apply, but the exact percentage (including whether it is 0% by default) is not visible here. Check your Policy Schedule and whether Optional Covers like 'Smart Select' / 'Co-Payment Option' were selected.

unclear.quote: If any sub-limits on Room Rent/Category for Medical Expenses are applicable as specified in the Policy Schedule... For diseases or conditions or procedure that have a specified sub-limit then all related expenses shall be covered up to the sub-limit specified
unclear.explanation: The wording allows for disease/procedure sub-limits if listed in your Policy Schedule, but the extract does not show whether any sub-limits are actually applied to your policy.
